<style>
:root{--bg:#f3f0e8;--surface:rgba(255,255,255,.74);--solid:#fffdf8;--rail:rgba(255,253,248,.6);--ink:#15171c;--ink2:#3a3e47;--muted:#737884;--line:rgba(20,22,30,.1);--line2:rgba(20,22,30,.18);

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{overflow-x:hidden}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Noto Sans SC","Space Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.55;min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent2);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
kbd{font-family:"Space Grotesk",monospace;font-size:.78em;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-bottom-width:2px;background:var(--solid)}
.num{font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.hidden{display:none!important}
.blobs{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.blobs i{position:absolute;width:55vmax;height:55vmax;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(90px);opacity:.42;animation:drift 26s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.blobs i:nth-child(1){background:var(--b1);left:-15vmax;top:-20vmax}.blobs i:nth-child(2){background:var(--b2);right:-20vmax;top:10vmax;animation-delay:-8s}.blobs i:nth-child(3){background:var(--b3);left:20vmax;bottom:-30vmax;animation-delay:-15s}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translate(8vmax,6vmax) scale(1.15)}}
#app{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:100vh}
.rail{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;padding:26px 18px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--rail);backdrop-filter:blur(24px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:900}
.brand .logo{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;background:conic-gradient(from 200deg,var(--accent),#ffb03a,var(--accent3),var(--accent2),var(--accent));display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:18px}
.brand small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em}
.steps{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;overflow:auto;flex:1;min-width:0}
.steps button{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:12px;text-align:left;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);transition:.25s}
.steps button:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.5}
.steps button:not(:disabled):hover{background:var(--line)}
.steps .dot{width:26px;height:26px;flex:none;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;font-family:"Space Grotesk";border:1.5px solid var(--line2)}
.steps li.done .dot{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ink)}
.steps li.cur button{color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--shadow);font-weight:700}
.steps li.cur .dot{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 22%,transparent)}
.rail-foot{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
main{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;height:4px;background:var(--line)}

#stage{flex:1;width:100%;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:36px clamp(16px,4vw,56px);transition:opacity .38s,transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),filter .38s}

.navbar{position:sticky;bottom:0;z-index:15;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px clamp(16px,4vw,56px);background:linear-gradient(to top,var(--bg) 55%,transparent)}
.navbar .mid{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:18px;height:2px;background:currentColor}
h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5.4vw,66px);line-height:1.06;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.02em}
h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3.2vw,36px);line-height:1.18;font-weight:900;margin:10px 0 8px}
h3{font-size:16px;font-weight:700}
.lead{color:var(--ink2);font-size:15px;max-width:720px}
.grad{background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--accent),#ffb03a 45%,var(--accent3) 70%,var(--accent2));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;background-size:200% 100%;animation:shine 6s linear infinite}
@keyframes shine{to{background-position:-200% 0}}
.qhead{margin-bottom:22px}
.card{position:relative;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}
.card+.card,.grid2+.card,.card+.grid2{margin-top:14px}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.lbl{display:block;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:10px}.lbl i{color:var(--accent);font-style:normal}
.hint{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--solid);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.35;pointer-events:none}
.btn-primary{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ink)}

.seg{display:flex;padding:4px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--line);gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.seg button{flex:1;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap}
